CURRENT HEADLINE

Human-Original Guarantee

Certification offices reserve the human-original seal for work whose production chain can be inspected. Institutions with credible records buy access to a premium market; the seal cannot supply a capability they lack.

Effect: Each institution with at least 3 Reputation may pay 1 Runway to gain 1 Customers. The next Customer card requires its normal Capability. This is not a Deploy action.

“The premium covers the person who was actually there.”

boundaries.name: four tracks and six areas form the browser engine state
Fund caps income and preserves the Reputation cost
Build limited slots reject a rival after two reservations
single upgrade flips the host and doubles its yield
Deploy takes a card, charges Compute and Reputation, triggers only its faction
Research bank and duplicate crash retain separate Reputation consequences
trade rejects wrong quantities and credits both sides atomically
Venture responder receives fixed public hosts and both nominal incomes
Venture refusal and provider failure clear terms and award nothing
nominal capacity is read-only, uncapped, and current-host dependent
Review follows income and recognition follows Review
zero qualifies in pure comparisons and different histories never change standings
all four objectives settle only at the final table
complete browser-native game respects action exhaustion, phases and hidden draw state
AGI diagnostics record one final opportunity per player with actual readiness and acceptance
